A '''skirmish''' took place in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Radiant IX]]'' on the asteroid [[Poison Moon/Legends|Poison Moon]] in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], between [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Et Rex]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alysun Celz]]. Celz was incapacitated by the Jedi, and brought back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to stand trial for the crimes she had committed.
